name: Loan amortization explorer
description: Native sliders write the interest rate and the annual payment to the data model. A ReactApp reads them live with useData, draws the remaining balance for ten years with VegaChart, and formats amounts with the catalog function formatCurrency. Clicking a bar writes /loan/selectedYear and /loan/selectedYearSummary, which a native Text shows. A native button sends the plan to the agent.

loan.selectedYearSummary: Click a bar to see a year.

components.title: Balance by year
